name: get_time
description: Get the current date and time, optionally for any location worldwide. Use for: 'what time is it', 'what time is it in Tokyo', 'what's the time in Paris', 'current time in London', 'what day is it', 'what's today's date'. Supports 100+ cities and all IANA timezones. If no location specified, returns local server time.

location.description: City or country name (e.g., 'Tokyo', 'Paris', 'New York', 'London'). Leave empty for local time.

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g., 'Asia/Tokyo', 'Europe/Paris'). Alternative to location parameter.
